mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening household demand, which reduces revenue growth for consumer-facing firms and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where RSAFS declines for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the industrial production index above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing output, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where INDPRO rises > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in both the federal funds rate and CPI above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25% AND CPIAUCSL rises > 0.25% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise > 0.25% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 50,000 signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where PAYEMS rises > 50,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the Housing Starts index above 5,000 units signals stronger residential investment, which benefits homebuilding and related sectors and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where HOUST rises > 5,000 units (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the industrial production index below -0.3% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline in periods where INDPRO falls < -0.3% (t-test p > 0.05).
